notes: sciCAN is not a pip library; the network and training code (network.py, training.py, Center_loss_pytorch.py, contrastive_loss_pytorch.py) is vendored beside main_sciCAN.py from rpmccordlab/sciCAN. Cycle_train_wolabel takes epoch, batch_size, the two data matrices and an optional encoder; the script sets epoch=200 and batch_size=1024. The remaining numeric settings are fixed in the vendored training.py: SGD lr=5e-3, weight_decay=5e-4, momentum=0.9 (lines 173-174), the inverse learning-rate schedule lr=0.001, gamma=0.001, power=0.75 (line 168), contrastive temperatures 0.15 and 0.5 (lines 178-179), loss weights 2.0 and 0.5 on the feature and prototype contrastive terms (lines 209-212), Wasserstein term weights 1.5 and 2.5 (lines 232-233), cycle-loss weight 3.0 (line 238), scCluster clf_out=25 (line 162) and seed = 1 (line 16). training.py calls .cuda() unconditionally (lines 162-166), so a GPU is required even though main_sciCAN.py moves the trained model to the CPU on line 50. No variable-feature selection is done: the full gene set is scaled with StandardScaler, so input_dim is the width of the input h5.

notes: main_totalVI.py is the joint-embedding script; main_totalVI_imputation.py is the imputation variant. The command line takes only --path1, --path2 and --save_path (lines 15-17). vae.train() (line 78) takes no arguments, so max_epochs, lr, batch_size, early_stopping, train_size and KL warm-up are scvi-tools defaults, as are n_latent=20, n_hidden=256, n_layers_encoder=2, n_layers_decoder=1 and dropout_rate_encoder/decoder=0.2. empirical_protein_background_prior=False departs from the library default, which enables the empirical prior for panels of more than 10 proteins; latent_distribution="normal" equals the default. No preprocessing is done: raw counts go to adata.layers["counts"] (line 68) without feature selection or normalization. main_totalVI_imputation.py fixes more: n_top_genes=4000 (line 128), n_layers_decoder=2 (line 135), batch_size=265 (line 136) and n_samples=25 (line 141), and it exposes --seed. Library defaults are those of the scvi-tools main branch; the version pinned in the method's environment may differ.
